hooks.name: Worker security checklist
hooks.description: Whenever a Worker route file is saved (not a test file), remind the agent of the project's security checklist (sign-in, rate limit, validation, no logging).

action.prompt: A Cloudflare Worker route file was just saved. Before you continue, check it against .kiro/steering/security.md: (1) the caller must be a signed-in user (requireUser in frontend/worker/guard.ts) with a per-user rate limit; (2) every input is validated and anything from the network or a model is cleaned before it is used or returned; (3) no photo, prompt, token or key is logged or returned; (4) errors return a short code and message, never internals. If a point does not hold, fix it and add or update the test in frontend/worker/*.test.ts.
